# Multiscale FEM Scattering

> Research software by Egoriy Monastyrev (MIT) for 2D heterogeneous Helmholtz wave scattering: complex P1 FEM, GMsFEM, POD/SVD-based SNO, Chebyshev-SNO and Fourier Neural Operators. Repository: https://github.com/Egoriy286/multiscale-fem-scattering

## Project and reproduction

- [Research overview and quickstart](README.md): scientific scope, scoped results, Docker commands, small-data example, repository map and artifact availability.
- [Software citation](CITATION.cff): author, software title, repository URL, license and keywords. Cite the exact commit and experiment configuration.
- [GMsFEM implementation](gmsfem/README.md): fine FEM, Type 1/2 multiscale bases, CLI and numerical checks.
- [GMsFEM mathematical formulation](gmsfem/docs/method.md): material interfaces, scattered/total fields, first-order absorbing boundary, snapshot spaces and spectral reduction.
- [Neural operator workflow](neural_operator/README.md): SVD-SNO, Chebyshev-SNO, FNO, training, comparison and inference.
- [Dataset generation and splits](neural_operator/docs/datasets.md): static versus variable media, deterministic generation, storage and frequency-grouped splits.
- [Neural methods and metric](neural_operator/docs/methods.md): train-only POD, DCT-I, Fourier layers, grid transfer and consistent complex P1 FEM L2.

## Committed research results

- [GMsFEM notebook-material report](gmsfem/results/notebook/report.md): k=1, fine FEM with 17,549 DOF, coarse systems and independent reference refinement.
- [GMsFEM paper-inspired-material report](gmsfem/results/paper_example1/report.md): a distinct material preset on the repository geometry.
- [Randomized SVD-SNO report](neural_operator/randomized/RESULTS.md): mean test errors 0.96% for k in [1,2] and 5.54% for k in [4,8], each on 1,280 held-out fields of one fixed medium.
- [Randomized SVD-SNO machine-readable results](neural_operator/randomized/static_results.json): experiment settings and recorded evaluation summaries.
- [Fixed-medium specification](neural_operator/docs/static_medium.md): 1,000 frequencies and 8 directions per band, shared fixed material and split provenance.
- [Cross-mesh inference study](neural_operator/docs/cross_mesh_inference.md): frozen source P1/POD transfer and its interpretation.
- [Primary method references](neural_operator/docs/references.md): literature attribution and limits of comparison.

Neural datasets and model.pt bundles are generated local artifacts under ignored data/runs directories; they are not included in a clone. Neural errors are measured against discrete FEM labels for one fixed medium. They do not establish new-material generalization or continuous-PDE accuracy; high-band mesh-refinement differences are about 13–14%. GMsFEM and standalone neural report presets differ. The software adapts the cited methods to its own geometry and experiments.
